title: On the class number of real multiquadratic fields
summary: In their 1988 monograph, Conner and Hurrelbrink classified all real quadratic and biquadratic fields with odd class number. They also investigated real quadratic fields whose $2$-class numbers are equal to $2$. Their results, together with some well-known results of Ku{č}era, provide a complete classification of real quadratic number fields with $2$-class number $2$. The main aim of this paper is to provide a complete classification of all real biquadratic fields whose $2$-class numbers equal $2$; and moreover, we draw the complete list all real multiquadratic fields with odd class numbers.…
